notes.title: patch v1.08a: more fixes :)
notes.notes:
[p]patch v1.08:
- cookpot should no longer cease to exist
- adjusted road signs
- you can make new save files again
- save system tweaks[/p][p][/p][p]AND patch v1.08a:[/p][p]- fixed save file issue for certain regions[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you were effected by the save file issue, here's how you can fix it:[/b][/p][p]Head to C:\\Users\\YOUR_USERNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\SamC\\EasyDeliveryCo[/p][p]in file explorer and edit the save file with notepad[/p][p]You'll have to edit the fields:
'deliveryMoney:'
and 'deliveryFuel:'[/p][p]For fuel place a '.' after the first one or two numbers (eg: "7040854" should be "7.040854")[/p][p]And same goes for money (eg. "1415134" should be "14.15134")[/p][p]Save, and relaunch the game and it should be fixed :)[/p][p][/p][p]Have an Easy day! (and so sorry for the trouble!!)[/p]

notes.title: Easy Delivery Co. 24 hours after launch: Thank you!!!! Also: fixes & stuff
notes.notes: [p]Hey hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First off I am happy to announce that over 20,000 people got Easy Delivery Co. in the past 24 hours which is absolutely crazy. And the game is (currently) rated at 95% positive. [/p][p]Every review and forum post is read, thank you for your kind words and feedback. If you have time please leave a review <3[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important note:[/b] [/p][p]The demo is now off Steam. The reason being is so much has changed in the final game compared to when the demo was initially released, all the way back in April. As of now it does not represent the full game and it might lead to confusion for what to expect in the full version. This was not an easy decision, thank you for understanding![/p][p][/p][p]There are some unintended behaviors and various bugs that have been reported which are being looked into![/p][p][/p][p][b]In terms of features and upcoming updates and QoL things:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Cloud saves are high priority for people playing between PC and Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Patching bugs and soft-locks[/p][/*][/list][p]The best way to report bugs and questions is through the [url="https://discord.com/invite/TDkZWmrET3"]Discord[/url] as there is channel dedicated to just that.[/p][p][/p][p]And here's some cool fanart shared by very lovely people in the Discord.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/6b830f497f2ba4b14f928ccbf1fdfdf240f659e9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Easy Delivery Co. launches on September 18th!
notes.notes: [p]Hello hello everyone, how exciting it is to finally reveal that Easy Delivery Co. will be in your hands very soon. In just one week to be exact![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Easy Delivery Co. will launch on Steam, September 18th at 4pm CEST // 10am EST // 7am PT[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]What started out as a little project on itch has now become quite the adventure. The game features 3 different areas for you to explore and deliver items in, with various truck upgrades allowing you to reach new places. Meet the residents of these towns, talk to them (or try to), and learn more about the snowy regions you found yourself in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]To celebrate the occasion, here is a brand new trailer showcasing some of the new stuff you can look forward to![/b] [/h3][previewyoutube="v7W_Xcrgyos;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Easy Delivery Co Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Different areas requiring different approaches to deliver in and explore [/p][/*][*][p]Radio stations to find and unlock with new music[/p][/*][*][p]Truck upgrades [/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetics for your character [b]and[/b] truck [/p][/*][*][p]Definitely nothing odd or concerning happening at all [/p][/*][*][p]The game will launch at 12.99 Euro / 12.99 USD with a 25% discount. Meaning the game will be 9.74 Euro / 9.74 USD after discount for the first 14 days of release.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If you've played the demo[/b], some small things have been slightly changed or modified. Overall this is to make the game more cohesive with the all the levels and mechanics in mind. What worked for the demo sometimes won't work in the full scope. So please prepare yourself to be pleasantly surprised! The early stages of the game are different to the demo, which should be fun :)[/p][p][/p][p]The game is officially Steam Deck verified! Valve has tested the game and now the sweet green checkmark is now on the game page. Easy Delivery Co. is really fun on handheld, and you don't need to create any custom button layout. Everything just works.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/a73539dd3955532b4f1c030ba9e9f37fd083adfd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The full soundtrack is also getting ready. Made by two artists, Sohaoying and pr0te, you will be able to discover their songs across the game as you find radio towers spread throughout the areas. To give you a snippet of what that sounds like there is a stream at the top of the game page which features 30 minutes of in-game music that was made just for Easy Delivery Co.! [/p][p][/p][p]Click on the game page to listen to some of the music playing now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293010/Easy_Delivery_Co/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]It's been amazing to see so many people play the demo and hanging out in the discord for the past months, I cannot wait for you to finally play the full game very soon. See you next week!![/p][p][/p][p]And finally, here is some amazing fan art that was shared in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/TDkZWmrET3"]Discord[/url] recently.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/23d13d00cad020dd38f7c3115d8a452f53aee994.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Progress Update on Easy Delivery Co.! 150K wishlists, truck upgrades & more
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]Hope y’all are doing well. Little note today to say that progress on Easy Delivery Co. is going well. The game is now feature complete! That means it’s now time to put all the bits and pieces together. On top of this nice milestone, [b]150,000 people have wishlisted the game!![/b] Thank you so much for your support it means a lot.[/p][p][/p][p]So, if you don’t mind, I’d like to share with you some of the new stuff that will be featured in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Truck Upgrades[/h3][p][/p][p]You will be able to buy some upgrades for your truck at a very reasonable price from store keepers around the area. Snow tires are now available for purchase to reach new areas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/1732ffd78641cf248fc95499851a77c9e5db5086.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Spending Money and Consumables[/h3][p][/p][p]Cool tools for your truck are not the only things you can purchase, coffee is a brand new alternative to energy drinks to live your liquid-based diet to the fullest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/f24c346f58750393f247a0384f05c60f2f5874b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Chill between deliveries[/h3][p][/p][p]In between deliveries, you can explore the various regions (yes, plural) to your heart’s desire. If you wish to slow things down a little more, feel free to buy some bird seed and hang out with the local crows. Also just, recently added - fishing! [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/2ba29c11b672a65a2018a6e11536c9d54691da2d.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]Fishing Village [/h3][p][/p][p]New area![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/a45c8be3b1d4f5d53fd74508452db45b4ade3253.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]People have also shared some cool art on the discord![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/b829ab85920e456908960c7afc21049d5f0e6d65.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now, thanks for reading and see you very very soon for more news on the launch :) In the meantime feel free to join the discord to hang out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/7de1fcc11e2d5b146e6a1217168758495a662e4f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update! Steering sensitivity, controller mapping, fixes.. and horn
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello hello everyone[/h3]

What a couple of weeks it's been! Tons of people have played the Easy Delivery Co. demo, about [b]30.000[/b] of you to be exact, and it's been a blast to see your reviews, your art, your feedback on the game. Thank you for playing and thank you for taking the time to leave reviews, it has really helped Easy Delivery Co. a lot. And we can't wait to show more about the game very soon :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/e075d9cc65657e3d32d2a8053945b0e90b5a4809.png[/img]

This update includes some fixes of course, but also fun stuff like new music, the truck can now honk, and steering sensitivity settings. You can find all the patch notes at the bottom of this post!

[h3]Some Questions & Answers [/h3]

[b]Does the demo run on Steam Deck?[/b] 
- Yes, we've seen people play on Deck or ROG Ally seamlessly so far. 

[b]When will the game launch?[/b]
- Late 2025 

[b]Will there be more to do with the truck?[/b]
- Yes

[b]How many secrets will be in the full game?[/b]
- Yes

[b]Will there be achievements?[/b] 
- Yes

[b]Will there be more areas to explore? [/b]
- Yes

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
[list][*] added brand new music tracks
[*] added horn
[*] added speed chime
[*] steering sensitivity setting
[*] crt effect setting
[*] alternate controller mapping
[*] dog sequence fixes
[*] fixed packages on npc head softlock
[*] packages can be placed under the fuel station
[/list]
Thanks for reading and see you next time! I will leave you with some lovely fan art from the community in the meantime. Come hang out [url=https://discord.com/invite/TDkZWmrET3]in the Discord[/url] to check out some videos, art, and speedruns of the game.

notes.title: The Easy Delivery Co. Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3] we're happy to announce that there is a shiny, brand new, demo for you all to try out. This announcement also comes with other news, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/orointeractive]Oro Interactive[/url] is now the official publisher for the game.

In Easy Delivery Co., take on the role of a delivery driver in a once-lively scenic mountain town now plagued by strange weather. Explore an ordinary town filled with odd secrets as you make deliveries and get to know its mysterious residents. Manage your energy, fuel, and temperature while navigating the challenges that come with each package.

Come hang out in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/TDkZWmrET3]Discord[/url]!

[h3]Play the Easy Delivery Co. Demo now[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293010/Easy_Delivery_Co/


[b]Features[/b]
[list][*] Earn a "living" by delivering packages with your kei truck
[*] Take in the atmospheric scenery or blitz through (road safety not required)
[*] Buy drastically overpriced gas and get to know the locals
[*] Simple controls and retro graphics
[*] Listen to cool beats while driving
[*] Split-screen race mode with up to four players
[*] Nothing strange going on, no lore, nothing at all, we promise 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/50da129aa96aec690bffbfc57f1ba83bc41f9186.gif[/img]
